bound_or_value.quantity: maximum corrected load in complete lot Lark

satisfied_premises: The complete lot consists of P and Q, each measured once on 2031-04-09.
The accepted acquisition assignment is P to amber and Q to blue.
The exact biases are amber = 2 glims and blue = 8 glims.
Corrected loads are P = 11 - 2 = 9 glims and Q = 17 - 8 = 9 glims.
Every corrected load is at most 12 glims.
rationale: The accepted acquisition record establishes the piece assignments, while the exact calibration establishes the profile biases. Applying those biases gives 9 glims for each piece. E1 establishes that P and Q constitute the complete lot and that no other corrections apply. Thus acceptance holds in every state compatible with the accepted evidence.
